summary: Latah County, ID temporary trailer lookout, c.1956, under Potlatch Timber Protective Association; listed as gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source gives a removal date or says what remains at the site
facts.location: about 7 miles north of Bovill, Latah County, Idaho

staffing.status: the Idaho Fire Lookouts page says it does not yet have records of the lookout's staffing

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site drive-up

events.note: Temporary trailer lookout: dated c.1956 on the Forest Lookouts page (credited to Kresek) and 1956 on firelookout.com

evidence.supports: page does not yet have records of staffing
evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1956 trailer date and type come from the Forest Lookouts page (citing Kresek); firelookout.com repeats the same date and gives no independent source. Two web searches found no other record or photo. No source describes the site today or its access. The PTPA quote is an abbreviation on the IFL page, used only as a check.
